invariants.rationale: A non-null instantTime is likely required for a commit operation to succeed as it typically identifies the commit.
The partitionRecordsMap argument should not be null to ensure records are available for committing.
If partitionRecordsMap is empty, it may be acceptable for instantTime to be any non-empty string, reflecting typical commit semantics.
instantTime is likely a strictly formatted time/string, so it is plausible there are no leading/trailing spaces.
